daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibes are asking you to slow down and actually listen—to others and yourself. There's magic in the pauses today, bestie. Trust the quiet moments.
daily.love: Your charm is naturally amplified rn. If you've been holding back a conversation, today feels like the right energy to be real with someone. Vulnerability hits different when you own it.
daily.career: Ideas are flowing but don't force them into existence yet. Jot things down, vibe with your team, and let inspiration breathe. Your best work comes from ease, not hustle.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentle movement today—think stretching, walking, or whatever feels like self-care rather than punishment. Hydration and rest are your unsung heroes rn.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to trust your gut more than your overthinking brain. Venus is vibing with your sector of self-discovery, so lean into what feels authentic rather than what looks good on the surface.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, this is about knowing your worth. Someone might test your boundaries—stay grounded. If you're dating, quality over quantity energy is *chef's kiss* right now.
weekly.career: Mercury's got your back with communication vibes. That idea you've been sitting on? Now's the time to pitch it or at least talk it through. Your voice carries more weight than you realize this week.
